desc.zh: 从第一个无法组成的和，推导最少补数的贪心法。
desc.en: Derive the minimum patches from the first sum you cannot form.

complexity: O(m + log n) time; O(1) auxiliary space

concepts.name: coverage invariant
concepts.description: Represent every attainable sum below miss by one complete interval.

concepts.name: greedy patch
concepts.description: Patch miss when the next sorted value cannot fill the first gap.
